overview: Alberta's two largest therapy markets behave differently: Calgary spreads demand across inner-city neighbourhoods, while Edmonton concentrates it around the university and downtown corridors. Both reward practices that state their scope plainly.
We serve Calgary and Edmonton practices remotely, with the same attention to professional advertising rules and honest claims.

city_blurbs.calgary: Inner-city neighbourhood demand, a steady stream of relocation clients and strong competition for anxiety and couples work.
city_blurbs.edmonton: A university-adjacent market with high demand for student-focused, trauma-informed and online sessions.
